claims.value: sources <set>_<time>: NHF2, NHF4_set1, NHF4_set2, NHF8, RDEBD, RDEBM, RDEBR x {0min,5min,10min}; individual NHF2/NHF4/NHF8/RDEBD/RDEBM/RDEBR; biological replicate NHF 1-4, RDEB 1-3 per (disease, time) group
claims.evidence: MaxQuant design has 7 Experiments (2NHF, 4NHF, 4NHFnew, 8NHF, RDEBD, RDEBM, RDEBR), 20 files each. readme: "Seven sets of SILAC-based AP-MS experiments ... (including one replicate using the same cell type)"; samples RDEB1-3, 2NHF, 4NHF_1, 4NHF_2, 8NHF. Paper Fig.1B legend: "Three different NHF (NHF2, 4, 8) and RDEB (RDEB1, 4, 5) cells were analyzed"; "Three different RDEB fibroblasts and three different NHFs". So 4NHF and 4NHFnew are two experiments from the same donor NHF4 (separate cultures -> distinct biological replicate numbers 2 and 3). The RDEB individual is given by the MaxQuant experiment code because the paper donor IDs (RDEB1/4/5) cannot be matched to RDEBD/M/R.

claims.value: v1.1.0; ms-proteomics v1.2.0, human v1.1.0, clinical-metadata v1.0.0; NT=sdrf-skills;VV=v0.1.0
claims.evidence: Campaign rules: sdrf version v1.1.0 (spec README.adoc:27); ms-proteomics latest 1.2.0 per upstream bigbio/sdrf-templates 7da1747 templates.yaml (the spec submodule nested templates copy is older); clinical-metadata declared because samples are patient/donor-derived primary cells.

limitations: Paper donor IDs (RDEB1, RDEB4, RDEB5 in Fig.1B) cannot be matched to MaxQuant experiments RDEBD/RDEBM/RDEBR; characteristics[individual] uses the deposit codes. Which of RDEBM/RDEBR is readme RDEB2 vs RDEB3 is unknown, but both carry the same channel map, so no row depends on it.

The assignment of readme samples RDEB1 and 4NHF_1 (label-swapped map) to MaxQuant experiments RDEBD and 4NHF rests on the deposited SILAC ratios (unstimulated channel = medium only in those two experiments; PDGFRB log2 M/L -3.3/-3.8), not on an explicit statement. The 5 vs 10 minute channels are taken from the readme; the data do not discriminate them strongly (H/M ~0).

characteristics[age] = not available: NHF donors were 2, 4, 8 and 9 years old and names NHF2/4/8 suggest the age, but no source states the per-donor age; RDEB donors only "less than one year". characteristics[sex] of RDEB donors and ancestry of all donors not reported (not available).

Technical replicate interpretation: the second 10-fraction series per experiment ("tR" files, and the 20160413 Q Exactive Plus series for 4NHF/RDEBD) is read as a re-measurement of the same gel-slice digests (same MaxQuant Experiment and fraction numbers 1-10); the paper does not describe the re-runs explicitly.

comment[precursor mass tolerance] = not available: MaxQuant 1.4.1.2 parameters.txt does not record first/main search precursor tolerance and no mqpar.xml was deposited; convert-openms therefore fails on this column (same as campaign precedents).

developmental stage "pediatric stage" is HsapDv:0000264, not an EFO term; validate-sdrf warns. Published Matrix Biol version (doi:10.1016/j.matbio.2021.10.004) not open access; the bioRxiv preprint was used.
